prompt_text: Where should I stay in Branson Missouri, an Airbnb or a hotel, and which specific places are best?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: it depends on what you want to do in Branson.

Quick guidance
- If your trip is primarily shows, restaurants and easy walking to theaters, pick a hotel on the 76 “Strip” or Branson Landing.
- If you want lake time, privacy, grilling and family space, pick a lakefront or Ozark cabin (Airbnb/Vrbo).
- If you want a resort experience with activities on site (golf, pools, marina), choose a resort hotel (Big Cedar, Chateau, Welk).
- If you want budget and convenience with predictable service, choose a mid‑range chain hotel.

Where to stay by travel style (specific suggestions)

1) Best for show-goers / nightlife / first-time visitors
- Hotels: Hilton Branson Convention Center (on/near the 76 Strip), Drury Plaza Hotel Branson (good family amenities & central location), Best Western Music Capital Inn (budget-friendly on the Strip).
- Airbnb-type: 1–2 bedroom condos on the 76 Strip or within walking distance of the theaters — search for “76 Highway”, “Branson Strip” or “Branson Landing condo”.

2) Best for lake activities / relaxing on the water
- Hotels/resorts: Chateau on the Lake (upscale, lakefront), Big Cedar Lodge (resort-style, outdoorsy and high end), Welk Resort Branson (condos with resort amenities).
- Airbnb/Vrbo: Table Rock Lake lakefront cabins or houses (Hollister / Indian Point / Point Lookout). Look for “private dock,” “lakefront,” or “secluded cabin.”

3) Best for families / multi‑room stays (pools, suites, easy meals)
- Hotels: Drury Plaza Hotel Branson (family suites, evening extras), Stone Castle Hotel & Conference Center (family themed suites), many Fairfield/Comfort Inn properties on Hwy 76.
- Airbnb: 3+ bedroom houses or large cabins with kitchens and multiple bathrooms.

4) Best for a romantic/quiet getaway
- Hotels/resorts: Chateau on the Lake, a private cabin at Big Cedar, or a boutique lakeside rental.
- Airbnb: Small, private cabins with hot tub and scenic views.

5) Best if you plan to visit Silver Dollar City / wilderness activities
- Stay closer to Branson West / Silver Dollar City (or Welk Resort area) to reduce drive time. Many cabins and condos in that direction; also family hotels near Hwy 76.

Practical tips
- Peak times: summer weekends, fall foliage, and holiday lights (November/December) book up fast — reserve early.
- If you’re doing many shows, staying on or very near the 76 Strip saves driving/time parking.
- If you have a boat or want to fish, confirm dock/boat parking and whether the property allows boats.
- Check cancellation policy, cleaning fees and whether the Airbnb has parking and cell/internet service.
- For groups/families, compare total cost (hotel fees + parking vs Airbnb cleaning/service fees).
- If you want certainty and daily housekeeping, a hotel is better. If you want space, kitchen and local feel, go Airbnb.

If you tell me your travel dates, budget, number of people and what you want to do (shows vs lake vs family activities), I’ll recommend 4–6 specific current hotels or Airbnb listings and where to book them.
